## Linked approved issue and evidence

## What changed and why
Describe relevant files, contracts, scope exclusions and user impact.

## Correctness and provenance
- [ ] Customer/account isolation checked, or not applicable.
- [ ] Financial figures generated by verified deterministic calculations, or not applicable.
- [ ] Source data, assumptions and synthetic examples identified, or not applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private data or unauthorized Pulp code copied.

## Actual verification
List commands run and their real results; state anything not tested.

## Risk and rollback
Describe possible regressions and a safe way to reverse the change.

## Independent review
- [ ] SENTRY-style findings addressed or documented.
- [ ] Human reviewer approves merge; no agent self-merges.
